_about: Feat loop, batch 1, manoeuvres lane (2026-11-22): the combat manoeuvre feats and their
relatives left without a document after round 3. Each benefit is the book's (aonprd.com
FeatDisplay, the source named in feats.json), every number through the funnel. The CMB
and CMD of a manoeuvre now carry its opponent (`target_actor` / `attacker_actor`) and the
moment, so a term may ask of the foe (`target.state`) and of the board (`ally_beside`,
`sole_threat`, sheet.Situation). What still does not run is the document's `not_yet`.
Loaded beside core.json by rules/feats.py; nothing here is in another lane's file.

modifiers.note: total Hit Dice in place of base attack bonus in CMD
Dexterity bonus added to CMB on a trip
against an enemy denied its Dexterity bonus to AC
the only one threatening the opponent
against the opponent you alone threaten
beside an ally with Coordinated Defense
beside an ally with Coordinated Defense, against a foe larger than both
beside an ally with Coordinated Maneuvers
breaking free of a grapple beside an ally with Coordinated Maneuvers
one size larger for CMD beside an ally with Wall of Flesh

not_yet: the size a manoeuvre's size limit reads ("the way combat maneuvers and abilities affect you") is still the body's own: a foe two sizes larger than your true size may still trip or bull rush you
the CMD step is +1, the step from Tiny and Small; a Diminutive or Fine bearer's larger step is not computed

modifiers.note: to escape a grapple or bonds

not_yet: a fear effect that fails to affect you does not yet give the +2 morale bonus on attack, weapon damage and CMB against its source for 1 round
